import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Fix body_mass_g - convert from text to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Fix sex label variant - strip whitespace
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    
    # Handle negative flipper_length_mm - set to NaN (invalid data)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    
    # Group by species and sum body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    
    return result
